terms.comment: Our description, with the classical canālis, a channel or groove: for a track, not a rod. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have words for the curtain (aulaeum, vēlum, Traupman 123, 300; cortīna, M-O s.v. curtain) but none for the track.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 300.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. curtain.
